name: list-retry
description: GET /agents/ is the only load-bearing request in the run, and it is a raw http.get because jsonstream needs the body -- so it sits outside get_json's built-in retry, and a transient 502 used to turn the whole run into a green zero-asset import. The hand-rolled bounded retry must repeat the request on a transient status and import normally when the reverse proxy recovers. The route answers 502 once and then serves one agent; request_count==2 pins the retry, and the asset pins the recovery. A persistent failure still ends the run with the printed error after three attempts.
